releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.97 fixes two Files organization issues. Files that already have a Category assignment are now excluded from Files > Search immediately and after reload, across Documents, Photos/Images and Videos; removing or moving a Category assignment refreshes Search automatically. Category cards also keep long names on one readable line and scale them down when needed, preventing awkward mid-word wrapping while preserving the current two-column card design. Files Search multi-select, batch Add to Category, permanent Category delete, thumbnails, indexing and all existing data remain unchanged.
